segments.sn22.143:1.2: “Yo, bhikkhave, anattā; tatra vo chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn22.143:1.4: Rūpaṃ, bhikkhave, anattā; tatra vo chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn22.143:1.5: Vedanā anattā … saññā … saṅkhārā … viññāṇaṃ anattā;
segments.sn22.143:1.9: Yo, bhikkhave, anattā; tatra vo chando pahātabbo”ti.
